mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_class_teacher t on t.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id where b.id = #{bindingId} and b.ended_at is null and t.user_id = #{userId} and t.valid_to is null

select count(1) from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_class_student s on s.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id where b.id = #{bindingId} and b.ended_at is null and s.user_id = #{userId} and s.left_at is null

select b.id as binding_id, b.teaching_class_id, b.course_space_id, cs.title as course_title, tc.name as class_name from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_course_space cs on cs.id = b.course_space_id inner join edu_teaching_class tc on tc.id = b.teaching_class_id where b.id = #{bindingId} and b.ended_at is null

select b.id as binding_id, b.teaching_class_id, b.course_space_id, cs.title as course_title, tc.name as class_name from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_teaching_class tc on tc.id = b.teaching_class_id inner join edu_course_space cs on cs.id = b.course_space_id inner join edu_class_teacher t on t.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id where t.user_id = #{userId} and t.valid_to is null and b.ended_at is null order by b.id

select b.id as binding_id, b.teaching_class_id, b.course_space_id, cs.title as course_title, tc.name as class_name from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_teaching_class tc on tc.id = b.teaching_class_id inner join edu_course_space cs on cs.id = b.course_space_id inner join edu_class_student s on s.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.left_at is null and b.ended_at is null order by b.id
select qv.id, qv.question_id, qv.question_kind, qv.stem, qv.options_json, qv.answer_json, qv.explanation, qv.max_score from edu_question_version qv where qv.id = #{questionVersionId}

select s.id as enrollment_id, s.user_id as student_user_id, b.teaching_class_id from edu_course_class_binding b inner join edu_class_student s on s.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id where b.id = #{bindingId} and b.ended_at is null and s.left_at is null

select r.id as release_id, r.resource_version_id, res.title as resource_title from edu_resource_class_release r inner join edu_resource res on res.id = r.resource_id inner join edu_resource_page p on p.resource_version_id = r.resource_version_id where r.binding_id = #{bindingId} and r.ended_at is null and r.opens_at <= utc_timestamp(3) and (r.closes_at is null or r.closes_at > utc_timestamp(3)) group by r.id, r.resource_version_id, res.title order by r.released_at desc limit 1

select l.id as lesson_id, lp.id as plan_id from edu_lesson l left join edu_lesson_plan lp on lp.lesson_id = l.id and lp.status = 'READY' where l.binding_id = #{bindingId} and l.status = 'ACTIVE' order by l.scheduled_at desc limit 1
select t.question_id, t.question_version_id from edu_activity_template t where t.binding_id = #{bindingId} and t.template_kind = 'QUIZ' and t.status = 'READY' order by t.id limit 1
